The following two Shiny apps demonstrate the effect of imperfect sensitivity and/or specificity of exposure and outcome measurements on risk differences, relative risk, and odds ratios.

- [Exposure Misclassification](https://cvmedlab.shinyapps.io/exposure_misclassification/)

- [Outcome Misclassification](https://cvmedlab.shinyapps.io/outcome_misclassification/)
